dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: It's not enough... Not enough at all...

dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: The treasure that Brother left me is in those conches...

dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: But they've been scattered, aye, they've been scattered all over...

dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: It's Brother's treasure. I can't leave yet, no, no...

response.speaker: Shitoki
response.text: He went out into the Sea of Fog, and that made the priest really angry. The priest said that my older brother's spirit would never be able to return...

response.speaker: Shitoki
response.text: But Brother said that "there are lovely flowers there and seas with pearls. Father rows a boat there, and he and our little sister wave to us..."

response.speaker: Shitoki
response.text: He left his treasure behind when he went out to sea, and he never returned.

choices.text: What's this I heard about a brother...

dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: Ah, I see, I see. So that's where the treasure was! Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: Though we won't be able to go to the land of dreams together, I'm sure I'll be able to turn into motes of light and return to look for you...

dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: Do strange spirits wandering in a strange land also dream, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: Shitoki
dialogues.text: No, no, I cannot leave. Not before I find his treasure...
